Artificial Intelligence is a powerful tool that offers opportunities and risks. As with any new technology, especially something as cutting-edge and revolutionary as AI, laws and regulations must keep pace with the tech’s capabilities. Congress must do its job and provide balanced oversight, standards, and rules of the road.

Consumers deserve transparent pricing and equal treatment, not hidden technology that misuses their personal data to set different prices for the same item and charge some shoppers more than others. AI is a powerful tool, but it presents real and pressing challenges. This is one of them and Congress needs to take thoughtful, concrete steps to ban exploitative AI-enabled price discrimination and ensure fairness in the marketplace.
